Rise 5.99 Blink — Full Source Analysis

Rise 5.99's Blink is a fake-lag module built around a single interception point: onPacketSend cancels the outgoing packet and parks it in a ConcurrentLinkedQueue, and onDisable replays the whole buffer through PacketUtil.sendPacketWithoutEvent so the server receives every stale packet in one burst. The allPackets toggle, on by default, cancels every packet class, while turning it off narrows the buffer to C03PacketPlayer only, a mode the class comment itself warns is trivially detectable. The pulse setting turns the module into a periodic fake-lagger: every delayPulse ticks (default 20, range 4 to 100, with a 10 percent random skip) the entire buffer flushes through the same event-bus bypass, so the server sees a player that stands still and then jumps forward in 20-tick steps. A showPlayer ghost entity renders the player's real position client-side while the server-side model is frozen, and onPreMotion records breadcrumb path points for the render layer. The buffer is cleared whenever the world state is unsafe (null player, dead, singleplayer, or under 150 ticks), which keeps stale packets from replaying across a respawn.

Analysis

Overview

Rise 5.99's Blink is a fake-lag module built around a single interception point: onPacketSend cancels the outgoing packet and parks it in a ConcurrentLinkedQueue, and onDisable replays the whole buffer through PacketUtil.sendPacketWithoutEvent so the server receives every stale packet in one burst. The allPackets toggle, on by default, cancels every packet class, while turning it off narrows the buffer to C03PacketPlayer only, a mode the class comment itself warns is trivially detectable. The pulse setting turns the module into a periodic fake-lagger: every delayPulse ticks (default 20, range 4 to 100, with a 10 percent random skip) the entire buffer flushes through the same event-bus bypass, so the server sees a player that stands still and then jumps forward in 20-tick steps. A showPlayer ghost entity renders the player's real position client-side while the server-side model is frozen, and onPreMotion records breadcrumb path points for the render layer. The buffer is cleared whenever the world state is unsafe (null player, dead, singleplayer, or under 150 ticks), which keeps stale packets from replaying across a respawn.

Buffer and flush cycle

onPacketSend adds every outgoing packet to the queue and cancels it, then the pulse branch runs inside the same handler: when the pulse toggle is on and the current tick count is an exact multiple of the delay setting, the handler iterates the queue and pushes each packet through sendPacketWithoutEvent before clearing it. The Math.random() > 0.1 guard means roughly one pulse in ten silently drops the whole buffer instead of flushing it, so the cadence is intentionally irregular. onDisable drains the queue the same way, and because sendPacketWithoutEvent routes around the event bus the flushed packets cannot be re-intercepted by this very handler. The path list used for breadcrumbs is capped at the pulse delay length while pulsing, and the showPlayer ghost is only spawned when both pulse and showPlayer are off.

Server-side footprint

With the default settings the server sees roughly 20 packets arrive in a single tick followed by 20 ticks of silence, an average near 20 packets per second that sits under common rate ceilings while the instantaneous burst is the fingerprint. In the all-packets mode the buffer also holds C00 keepalives, C0F confirmations, C0B entity actions and C02 attacks, so the flush replays the entire gameplay stream at once, and the keepalive echoes arrive long after the server issued their keys. With allPackets off and pulse off, the module produces one long silent gap and then a replay of the whole path in a single tick.

Detection surface

The flush presents every buffered move as a single-tick sequence: the first replayed move is a jump from the last position the server tracked, and every later move is stale relative to any correction the server applied during the gap. The pulse mode shrinks the gap to about a second so the first move of each flush stays small, but the per-flush burst remains, and a set-back that lands mid-blink leaves the buffered path starting from a pre-correction location, so the next flush begins with a divergence the envelope checks can see.

What this file does

onPacketSend is the single chokepoint: every outgoing packet is added to the ConcurrentLinkedQueue and cancelled, and the pulse branch runs inside this same handler, so a C03 arriving mid-blink can trigger a flush of the whole buffer. onDisable drains the queue through PacketUtil.sendPacketWithoutEvent, which routes around the event bus and therefore cannot be re-buffered by this handler. The tick guards (null player, dead, singleplayer, ticksExisted under 150) clear the buffer instead of flushing it, so a blink cannot survive a world join. The path list and the blinkEntity ghost are render-side state maintained by onPreMotion and onRender3DEvent.

What this file does

The flush carrier. sendPacketWithoutEvent delegates to NetHandlerPlayClient.addToSendQueueWithoutEvent, the fork's bypass that enqueues the packet straight into the network layer without firing the send event. Every replay in the module, pulsed or on disable, goes through this one method; without it the flushed packets would re-enter onPacketSend and be cancelled again, which would make the module unable to ever deliver its buffer.

How it counteracts this module

NoCheatPlus MorePackets scores every arriving move into 500ms buckets against a 22 packets per second window and a half-second burst path (default 15 packets). The pulse flush lands the whole buffer, about 20 C03s at the default delay, in a single tick, so the newest half-second bucket trips the burst path on every pulse; the disable flush of a long all-packets blink delivers the accumulated stream at once, which drives the window accumulator above the ceiling and pushes toward the direct-violation threshold. The module's average rate near 20 per second stays under the window ceiling, so the instantaneous burst is the lever that catches it.

        boolean cancel = false;
385
        // Check if the player had been in bed at all.
386
        if (!data.wasInBed) {
387
            // Violation ...
388
            tags.add("bedfly");
389
            data.survivalFlyVL += 100D;
390
            Improbable.check(player, (float) 5.0, System.currentTimeMillis(), "moving.survivalfly.bedfly", DataManager.getPlayerData(player));
391
            final ViolationData vd = new ViolationData(this, player, data.survivalFlyVL, 100D, cc.survivalFlyActions);
392
            if (vd.needsParameters()) vd.setParameter(ParameterName.TAGS, StringUtil.join(tags, "+"));
393
            cancel = executeActions(vd).willCancel();
394
        }
395
        // Nothing detected.
396
        else data.wasInBed = false;
397
        return cancel;
398
    }

    /**
402
     * Check for push/pull by pistons, alter data appropriately (blockChangeId).
403
     */
404
    private double[] getVerticalBlockMoveResult(final double yDistance, final PlayerLocation from, final PlayerLocation to, final MovingData data) {
405
        /*
406
         * TODO: Pistons pushing horizontally allow similar/same upwards
407
         * (downwards?) moves (possibly all except downwards, which is hard to
408
         * test :p).
409
         */
410
        // TODO: Allow push up to 1.0 (or 0.65 something) even beyond block borders, IF COVERED [adapt PlayerLocation].
411
        // TODO: Other conditions/filters ... ?
412
        // Push (/pull) up.
413
        if (yDistance > 0.0) {
414
            if (yDistance <= 1.015) {
415
                /*
416
                 * (Full blocks: slightly more possible, ending up just above
417
                 * the block. Bounce allows other end positions.)
418
                 */
419
                // TODO: Is the air block wich the slime block is pushed onto really in?
420
                if (from.matchBlockChange(blockChangeTracker, data.blockChangeRef, Direction.Y_POS, Math.min(yDistance, 1.0))) {
421
                    if (yDistance > 1.0) {
422
                        if (to.getY() - to.getBlockY() >= 0.015) {
423
                            // Exclude ordinary cases for this condition.
424
                            return null;
425
                        }
426
                    }
427
                    tags.add("blkmv_y_pos");
428
                    final double maxDistYPos = yDistance; //1.0 - (from.getY() - from.getBlockY()); // TODO: Margin ?
429
                    return new double[]{maxDistYPos, 0.0};
430
                }
431
            }
432
        }
433
        // Push (/pull) down.
434
        else if (yDistance < 0.0 && yDistance >= -1.0) {
435
            if (from.matchBlockChange(blockChangeTracker, data.blockChangeRef, Direction.Y_NEG, -yDistance)) {
436
                tags.add("blkmv_y_neg");
437
                final double maxDistYNeg = yDistance; // from.getY() - from.getBlockY(); // TODO: Margin ?
438
                return new double[]{maxDistYNeg, 0.0};
439
            }
440
        }
441
        // Nothing found.
442
        return null;
443
    }

    /**
447
     * Determine the allowed h / v distance for gliding.
448
     * Handled in its own method because of vertical and horizontal motion being too intertwined to separate (y-distance changes relate to h-distance changes). <br>
449
     * Consistency checks are done within the {@link fr.neatmonster.nocheatplus.checks.combined.CombinedListener}.<br>
450
     * <li> NOTE: this should be called with {@link Bridge1_9#isGliding(LivingEntity)} not {@link Bridge1_9#isGlidingWithElytra(Player)}, because the client does not check for elytra to apply the corresponding motion (EntityLiving, travel())</li>
451
     *
452
     * @return the allowed xyz distances + distances above limit.
453
     */
454
    private double[] processGliding(final PlayerLocation from, final PlayerLocation to, final IPlayerData pData, final MovingData data,
455
                                    final Player player, boolean isNormalOrPacketSplitMove, final boolean fromOnGround, final boolean toOnGround, final boolean debug) {
456
        final PlayerMoveData lastMove = data.playerMoves.getFirstPastMove();
457
        final PlayerMoveData thisMove = data.playerMoves.getCurrentMove();
458
        final CombinedData cData = pData.getGenericInstance(CombinedData.class);
459
        double yDistanceAboveLimit = 0.0, hDistanceAboveLimit = 0.0;
460
        // TODO: What with gliding + rocket boosting + riptiding + bouncing on slimes/beds while riptiding? LMAO
461
        // Beats me why Mojang keeps letting players perform such ridiculous moves.
462
        if (!Bridge1_9.isGliding(player)) {
463
            // No Gliding, no deal
464
            return new double[] {thisMove.hDistance, 0.0, thisMove.yDistance, 0.0};
465
        }
466
        // Note: WASD key presses, as well as sneaking and item-use are irrelevant when gliding.
467
        // Initialize speed.
468
        thisMove.xAllowedDistance = lastMove.toIsValid ? lastMove.xDistance : 0.0;
469
        thisMove.yAllowedDistance = lastMove.toIsValid ? lastMove.yDistance : 0.0;
470
        thisMove.zAllowedDistance = lastMove.toIsValid ? lastMove.zDistance : 0.0;
471
        // Reset momentum if collided with something on the previous tick.
472
        doWallCollision(lastMove, thisMove);
473
        // Throttle speed if stuck in a block.
474
        if (TrigUtil.lengthSquared(data.lastStuckInBlockHorizontal, data.lastStuckInBlockVertical, data.lastStuckInBlockHorizontal) > 1.0E-7) {
475
            if (data.lastStuckInBlockVertical != 1.0) {
476
                thisMove.yAllowedDistance = 0.0;
477
            }
478
            if (data.lastStuckInBlockHorizontal != 1.0) {
479
                thisMove.xAllowedDistance = thisMove.zAllowedDistance = 0.0;
480
            }
481
        }
482
        // Reset speed if judged to be negligible.
483
        checkNegligibleMomentum(pData, thisMove);
484
        checkNegligibleMomentumVertical(pData, thisMove, null);
485
        // Yes, players can glide and riptide at the same time, increasing speed at a faster rate than chunks can load...
486
        // Surely a questionable decision on Mojang's part.
487
        // NOTE: For the elytra, this has to be done before applying gravity and other motion changes.
488
        if (thisMove.tridentRelease.decideOptimistically()) {
489
            thisMove.tridentRelease = AlmostBoolean.YES;
490
            Vector riptideVelocity = to.getRiptideVelocity(false); // Cannot glide while on ground, so no need to check for it.
491
            thisMove.xAllowedDistance += riptideVelocity.getX();
492
            thisMove.yAllowedDistance += riptideVelocity.getY();
493
            thisMove.zAllowedDistance += riptideVelocity.getZ();
494
        }
495
        // TODO: Reduce verbosity (at least, make it easier to look at)
496
        Vector viewVector = TrigUtil.getLookingDirection(to, player);
497
        float radianPitch = to.getPitch() * TrigUtil.toRadians;
498
        // Horizontal length of the look direction
499
        double viewVecHorizontalLength = MathUtil.dist(viewVector.getX(), viewVector.getZ());
500
        // Horizontal length of the movement
501
        double thisMoveHDistance = MathUtil.dist(thisMove.xAllowedDistance, thisMove.zAllowedDistance); // NOTE: MUST BE the ALLOWED distances.
502
        // Overall length of the look direction.
503
        double viewVectorLength = viewVector.length();
504
        // Mojang switched from their own cosine function to the standard Math.cos() one in 1.18.2
505
        double cosPitch = pData.getClientVersion().isAtMost(ClientVersion.V_1_18_2) ? TrigUtil.cos((double)radianPitch) : Math.cos((double)radianPitch);
506
        cosPitch = cosPitch * cosPitch * Math.min(1.0, viewVectorLength / 0.4);
507
        // Base gravity when gliding.
508
        thisMove.yAllowedDistance += (cData.wasSlowFalling && lastMove.yDistance <= 0.0 ? Magic.SLOW_FALL_GRAVITY : Magic.DEFAULT_GRAVITY) * (-1.0 + cosPitch * 0.75);
509
        double baseSpeed;
510
        if (thisMove.yAllowedDistance < 0.0 && viewVecHorizontalLength > 0.0) {
511
            // Slow down.
512
            baseSpeed = thisMove.yAllowedDistance * -0.1 * cosPitch;
513
            thisMove.xAllowedDistance += viewVector.getX() * baseSpeed / viewVecHorizontalLength;
514
            thisMove.yAllowedDistance += baseSpeed;
515
            thisMove.zAllowedDistance += viewVector.getZ() * baseSpeed / viewVecHorizontalLength;
516
        }
517
        if (radianPitch < 0.0 && viewVecHorizontalLength > 0.0) {
518
            // Looking down speeds up the player.
519
            baseSpeed = thisMoveHDistance * (double) (-TrigUtil.sin(radianPitch)) * 0.04;
520
            thisMove.xAllowedDistance += -viewVector.getX() * baseSpeed / viewVecHorizontalLength;
521
            thisMove.yAllowedDistance += baseSpeed * 3.2;
522
            thisMove.zAllowedDistance += -viewVector.getZ() * baseSpeed / viewVecHorizontalLength;
523
        }
524
        if (viewVecHorizontalLength > 0.0) {
525
            // Accelerate
526
            thisMove.xAllowedDistance += (viewVector.getX() / viewVecHorizontalLength * thisMoveHDistance - thisMove.xAllowedDistance) * 0.1;
527
            thisMove.zAllowedDistance += (viewVector.getZ() / viewVecHorizontalLength * thisMoveHDistance - thisMove.zAllowedDistance) * 0.1;
528
        }
529
        // Boosted with a firework: propel the player.
530
        if (data.fireworksBoostDuration > 0) {
531
            // TODO: Firework netcode is horrible (a single firework can tick twice on the same tick, skipping the subsequent one), so simply applying the increase of speed won't cut it.
532
            // Not even sure if we can predict this at all without some kind of hacks / workarounds.
533
            thisMove.xAllowedDistance += viewVector.getX() * 0.1 + (viewVector.getX() * 1.5 - thisMove.xAllowedDistance) * 0.5;
534
            thisMove.yAllowedDistance += viewVector.getY() * 0.1 + (viewVector.getY() * 1.5 - thisMove.yAllowedDistance) * 0.5;
535
            thisMove.zAllowedDistance += viewVector.getZ() * 0.1 + (viewVector.getZ() * 1.5 - thisMove.zAllowedDistance) * 0.5;
536
        }
537
        // Friction here. (TEST)
538
        // Note about inertia: the game assigns the radian pitch to the "f" variable, which is the variable used to apply friction at the end of the tick, _normally_.
539
        // However, with gliding, the game does not use the f variable at the end of the tick, but instead applies the magic value of 0.99.
540
        thisMove.xAllowedDistance *= 0.99;
541
        thisMove.yAllowedDistance *= data.lastFrictionVertical;
542
        thisMove.zAllowedDistance *= 0.99;
543
        // Stuck-speed with the updated multiplier (both at the end)
544
        if (TrigUtil.lengthSquared(data.nextStuckInBlockHorizontal, data.nextStuckInBlockVertical, data.nextStuckInBlockHorizontal) > 1.0E-7) {
545
            thisMove.xAllowedDistance *= (double) data.nextStuckInBlockHorizontal;
546
            thisMove.yAllowedDistance *= (double) data.nextStuckInBlockVertical;
547
            thisMove.zAllowedDistance *= (double) data.nextStuckInBlockHorizontal;
548
        }
549
        // Collisions last.
550
        Vector collisionVector = from.collide(new Vector(thisMove.xAllowedDistance, thisMove.yAllowedDistance, thisMove.zAllowedDistance), fromOnGround || thisMove.fromLostGround, from.getBoundingBox());
551
        thisMove.collideX = collisionVector.getX() != thisMove.xAllowedDistance;
552
        thisMove.collideY = collisionVector.getY() != thisMove.yAllowedDistance;
553
        thisMove.collideZ = collisionVector.getZ() != thisMove.zAllowedDistance;
554
        thisMove.collidesHorizontally = thisMove.collideX || thisMove.collideZ;
555
        thisMove.xAllowedDistance = collisionVector.getX();
556
        thisMove.yAllowedDistance = collisionVector.getY();
557
        thisMove.zAllowedDistance = collisionVector.getZ();
558
559
        // Can a vertical workaround apply? If so, override the prediction.
560
        if (MagicWorkarounds.checkPostPredictWorkaround(data, fromOnGround, toOnGround, from, to, thisMove.yAllowedDistance, player, isNormalOrPacketSplitMove)) {
561
            thisMove.yAllowedDistance = thisMove.yDistance;
562
        }
563
564
        ////////////////////////////
565
        /// Calculate offests     //
566
        ////////////////////////////
567
        /* Expected difference from current to allowed */
568
        final double offsetV = thisMove.yDistance - thisMove.yAllowedDistance;
569
        if (Math.abs(offsetV) < Magic.PREDICTION_EPSILON) {
570
            // Accuracy margin.
571
        }
572
        else {
573
            // If velocity can be used for compensation, use it.
574
            if (data.getOrUseVerticalVelocity(thisMove.yDistance).isEmpty()) {
575
                yDistanceAboveLimit = Math.max(yDistanceAboveLimit, Math.abs(offsetV));
576
                tags.add("vdistrel");
577
            }
578
        }
579
580
        thisMove.hAllowedDistance = MathUtil.dist(thisMove.xAllowedDistance, thisMove.zAllowedDistance);
581
        final double offsetH = thisMove.hDistance - thisMove.hAllowedDistance;
582
        if (offsetH < Magic.PREDICTION_EPSILON) {
583
            // Accuracy margin.
584
        }
585
        else {
586
            hDistanceAboveLimit = Math.max(hDistanceAboveLimit, offsetH);
587
            if (hDistanceAboveLimit > 0.0) {
588
                tags.add("hdistrel");
589
            }
590
        }
591
        if (debug) {
592
            player.sendMessage(ChatColor.RED + "[SurvivalFly] vdistrel: predict=" + StringUtil.fdec6.format(thisMove.yAllowedDistance) + ", actual=" + StringUtil.fdec6.format(thisMove.yDistance) + ", offset=" + StringUtil.fdec6.format(offsetV));
593
            player.sendMessage(ChatColor.YELLOW + "[SurvivalFly] hdistrel: predict=" + StringUtil.fdec6.format(thisMove.hAllowedDistance) + ", actual=" + StringUtil.fdec6.format(thisMove.hDistance) + ", offset=" + StringUtil.fdec6.format(offsetH));
594
        }
595
        return new double[]{thisMove.hAllowedDistance, hDistanceAboveLimit, thisMove.yAllowedDistance, yDistanceAboveLimit};
596
    }

    /**
599
     * Reset the given speed upon wall collision.
600
     *
601
     * @param lastMove
602
     * @param thisMove
603
     */
604
    private void doWallCollision(PlayerMoveData lastMove, PlayerMoveData thisMove) {
605
        if (lastMove.collideX) {
606
            thisMove.xAllowedDistance = 0.0;
607
        }
608
        if (lastMove.collideZ) {
609
            thisMove.zAllowedDistance = 0.0;
610
        }
611
    }

613
    /**
614
     * Check if the allowed speed set in thisMove should be canceled due to it being lower than the negligible speed threshold. <br>
615
     * (Horizontal only)
616
     *
617
     * @param pData
618
     * @param thisMove
619
     */
620
    private void checkNegligibleMomentum(IPlayerData pData, PlayerMoveData thisMove) {
621
        if (pData.getClientVersion().isAtLeast(ClientVersion.V_1_21_5)) {
622
            // This condition was added on 1.21.5. If the horizontal distance squared is below 0.000009 and the entity is a player, both horizontal momenta are set to 0.0.
623
            // This means that both x/z momenta can be reset even if one of them is above the threshold, as long as the overall horizontal momentum is below the threshold.
624
            // EntityLiving.java -> aiStep
625
            // We use the unchecked hDistance for performance reasons (no sqrt needed).
626
            if (thisMove.hDistance < Magic.NEGLIGIBLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD) {
627
                thisMove.xAllowedDistance = 0.0;
628
                thisMove.zAllowedDistance = 0.0;
629
            }
630
        }
631
        else if (pData.getClientVersion().isAtLeast(ClientVersion.V_1_9)) {
632
            if (Math.abs(thisMove.xAllowedDistance) < Magic.NEGLIGIBLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD) {
633
                thisMove.xAllowedDistance = 0.0;
634
            }
635
            if (Math.abs(thisMove.zAllowedDistance) < Magic.NEGLIGIBLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD) {
636
                thisMove.zAllowedDistance = 0.0;
637
            }
638
        }
639
        else {
640
            // In 1.8 and lower, momentum is compared to 0.005 instead.
641
            if (Math.abs(thisMove.xAllowedDistance) < Magic.NEGLIGIBLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD_LEGACY) {
642
                thisMove.xAllowedDistance = 0.0;
643
            }
644
            if (Math.abs(thisMove.zAllowedDistance) < Magic.NEGLIGIBLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD_LEGACY) {
645
                thisMove.zAllowedDistance = 0.0;
646
            }
647
        }
648
    }
649
650
    /**
651
     * Check if the allowed speed set in thisMove should be canceled due to it being lower than the negligible speed threshold. <br>
652
     * (Vertical only).
653
     *
654
     * @param pData
655
     * @param thisMove
656
     * @param yTheoreticalDistance
657
     */
658
    private void checkNegligibleMomentumVertical(IPlayerData pData, PlayerMoveData thisMove, double[] yTheoreticalDistance) {
659
        final double threshold = pData.getClientVersion().isAtLeast(ClientVersion.V_1_9) ? Magic.NEGLIGIBLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD : Magic.NEGLIGIBLE_SPEED_THRESHOLD_LEGACY;
660
        final boolean direct = yTheoreticalDistance == null;
661
        if (direct) {
662
            if (Math.abs(thisMove.yAllowedDistance) < threshold) {
663
                thisMove.yAllowedDistance = 0.0;
664
            }
665
        } else {
666
            for (int i = 0; i < yTheoreticalDistance.length; i++) {
667
                if (Math.abs(yTheoreticalDistance[i]) < threshold) {
668
                    yTheoreticalDistance[i] = 0.0;
669
                }
670
            }
671
        }
672
    }
673
674
    /**
675
     * Prepares the estimation for horizontal speed of the player based on various conditions.
676
     *
677
     * @param forceSetOnGround Whether to forcibly consider the ground status of the player (despite being off ground).
678
     * @param forceSetOffGround Whether to forcibly ignore the ground status of the player (despite being on the ground).
679
     * @param isNormalOrPacketSplitMove Whether this movement has been corrected due to a faulty PlayerMoveEvent or is normal (no correction needed)
680
     *
681
     * @return hAllowedDistance, hDistanceAboveLimit
682
     */
683
    private double[] prepareSpeedEstimation(final PlayerLocation from, final PlayerLocation to, final IPlayerData pData, final Player player,
684
                                            final MovingData data, final PlayerMoveData thisMove, final PlayerMoveData lastMove,
685
                                            final boolean fromOnGround, final boolean toOnGround, final boolean debug,
686
                                            final boolean isNormalOrPacketSplitMove, boolean forceSetOnGround, boolean forceSetOffGround) {
687
        double hDistanceAboveLimit;
688
        //////////////////////////
689
        // Early return(s)      //
690
        //////////////////////////
691
        if (!isNormalOrPacketSplitMove) {
692
            // Bukkit-based split move: predicting the next speed is not possible due to coordinates not being reported correctly by Bukkit (and without ProtocolLib, it's nearly impossible to achieve precision here)
693
            thisMove.xAllowedDistance = thisMove.xDistance;
694
            thisMove.zAllowedDistance = thisMove.zDistance;
695
            thisMove.hAllowedDistance = thisMove.hDistance;
696
            hDistanceAboveLimit = 0.0;
697
            return new double[]{thisMove.hAllowedDistance, hDistanceAboveLimit};
698
        }
699
700
        boolean onGround = PhysicsGroundResolver.resolvePhysicsOnGround(from, thisMove, lastMove, forceSetOnGround, forceSetOffGround);
701
        /* All moves are assumed to be predictable, unless there are technical limitations / bugs / glitches that we cannot solve */
702
        boolean isPredictable;
703
        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
704
        // Estimate the horizontal speed (per-move distance check)  //
705
        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
706
        // Determine inertia and acceleration to calculate speed with.
707
        // Only check using the 'from' position because it is the current location of the player (NMS-wise)
708
        if (from.isInWater()) {
709
            data.nextInertia = Bridge1_13.isSwimming(player) ? Magic.HORIZONTAL_SWIMMING_INERTIA : Magic.WATER_HORIZONTAL_INERTIA;
710
            /* Per-tick speed gain. */
711
            float acceleration = Magic.LIQUID_ACCELERATION;
712
            float StriderLevel = attributeAccess.getHandle().getWaterMovementEfficiency(player);
713
            if (!onGround) {
714
                StriderLevel *= Magic.STRIDER_OFF_GROUND_MULTIPLIER;
715
            }
716
            if (StriderLevel > 0.0) {
717
                // (Less speed conservation (or in other words, more friction))
718
                data.nextInertia += (0.54600006f - data.nextInertia) * StriderLevel / (pData.getClientVersion().isAtMost(ClientVersion.V_1_20_6) ? 3.0f : 1.0f); // Mojang removed this / by 3 in 1.21 and switched to the WATER_MOVEMENT_EFFICIENCY attribute
719
                // (More per-tick speed gain)
720
                acceleration += (data.walkSpeed - acceleration) * StriderLevel / (pData.getClientVersion().isAtMost(ClientVersion.V_1_20_6) ? 3.0f : 1.0f);
721
            }
722
            if (!Double.isInfinite(Bridge1_13.getDolphinGraceAmplifier(player))) {
723
                // (Much more speed conservation (or in other words, much less friction))
724
                // (Overrides swimming AND depth strider friction)
725
                data.nextInertia = Magic.DOLPHIN_GRACE_INERTIA;
726
            }
727
            // Run through all operations
728
            isPredictable = estimateNextSpeed(player, acceleration, pData, tags, to, from, debug, fromOnGround, toOnGround, onGround, forceSetOffGround);
729
        }
730
        else if (from.isInLava()) {
731
            data.nextInertia = Magic.LAVA_HORIZONTAL_INERTIA;
732
            isPredictable = estimateNextSpeed(player, Magic.LIQUID_ACCELERATION, pData, tags, to, from, debug, fromOnGround, toOnGround, onGround, forceSetOffGround);
733
        }
734
        else {
735
            data.nextInertia = onGround ? data.nextFrictionHorizontal * Magic.AIR_HORIZONTAL_INERTIA : Magic.AIR_HORIZONTAL_INERTIA;
736
            // 1.12 (and below) clients will use cubed inertia, not cubed friction here. The difference isn't significant except for blocking speed and bunnyhopping on soul sand, which are both slower on 1.8
737
            float frictionMediumFactor = pData.getClientVersion().isAtLeast(ClientVersion.V_1_13) ? data.nextFrictionHorizontal : data.nextFrictionHorizontal * Magic.AIR_HORIZONTAL_INERTIA;
738
            float acceleration = onGround ? data.walkSpeed * ((pData.getClientVersion().isAtLeast(ClientVersion.V_1_13) ? Magic.DEFAULT_FRICTION_CUBED : Magic.DEFAULT_FRICTION_MULTIPLIED_BY_091_CUBED) / (frictionMediumFactor * frictionMediumFactor * frictionMediumFactor)) : Magic.AIR_ACCELERATION;
739
            if (pData.isSprinting()) {
740
                // (We don't use the attribute here due to desync issues, just detect when the player is sprinting and apply the multiplier manually)
741
                acceleration += acceleration * 0.3f; // 0.3 is the effective sprinting speed (EntityLiving).
742
            }
743
            isPredictable = estimateNextSpeed(player, acceleration, pData, tags, to, from, debug, fromOnGround, toOnGround, onGround, forceSetOffGround);
744
        }
745
746
        /////////////////////////////////////////////////
747
        // Set the combined allowed horizontal speed   //
748
        /////////////////////////////////////////////////
749
        thisMove.hAllowedDistance = MathUtil.dist(thisMove.xAllowedDistance, thisMove.zAllowedDistance);
750
751
        ////////////////////////
752
        // Calculate offsets  //
753
        ////////////////////////
754
        final MovingConfig cc = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingConfig.class);
755
        if (isPredictable) {
756
            hDistanceAboveLimit = handlePredictableMove(thisMove, cc.survivalFlyStrictHorizontal);
757
        }
758
        else hDistanceAboveLimit = handleUnpredictableMove(thisMove, cc.survivalFlyStrictHorizontal);
759
        hDistanceAboveLimit = applyEdgeCornerResolvedTolerance(thisMove, hDistanceAboveLimit, cc.survivalFlyStrictHorizontal);
760
        hDistanceAboveLimit = HiddenMotionReconstructor.applyEdgeSneakBypass(player, pData, data, from, lastMove, thisMove, hDistanceAboveLimit, tags);
761
        if (hDistanceAboveLimit > 0.0) {
762
            tags.add("hdistrel");
763
            if (debug) {
764
                player.sendMessage(ChatColor.YELLOW + "[SurvivalFly] hdistrel: predicted=" + StringUtil.fdec6.format(thisMove.hAllowedDistance) + ", actual=" + StringUtil.fdec6.format(thisMove.hDistance));
765
            }
766
        }
767
        return new double[]{thisMove.hAllowedDistance, hDistanceAboveLimit};
768
    }
769
770
771
    /**
772
     * Estimates the player's horizontal speed based on the given data and Minecraft's movement logic.<br>
773
     * Order of operations is essential. Do not shuffle things around unless you know what you're doing.
774
     *<hr>
775
     * <p>Order of client-movement operations (as per MCP tool):
776
     * <ul>
777
     * <li>{@code EntityLiving.tick()}
778
     * <li>{@code [Entity].tick()}
779
     *   <ul>
780
     *     <li>{@code baseTick()}
781
     *     <li>{@code updateInWaterStateAndDoFluidPushing()}
782
     *   </ul>
783
     * <li>{@code EntityLiving.aiStep()}
784
     *   <ul>
785
     *     <li>Decrease the jump delay counter if it is active ({@code this.noJumpDelay > 0})
786
     *     <li>Negligible speed reset (0.003)
787
     *     <li>Apply liquid motion if the player is pressing the space bar (vertical axis only)
788
     *     <li>Multiply the input vector (= the vector containing the player's WASD impulse) by 0.98</li>
789
     *     <li>{@code jumpFromGround()} is called if the player is on ground and has pressed the space bar.
790
     *   </ul>
791
     * <li>Begin executing {@code EntityLiving.travel()} ({@code In EntityLiving.aiStep()})<p> <b>Note:</b> from 1.21.2 and onwards, Mojang split the travel function into different helper methods to better
792
     * distinguish between media (we now have {@code travelInAir()}, {@code travelInFluid()} and {@code travelFallFlying()})</p><br>
793
     *   <ul>
794
     *     <li>Invoke {@code [Entity].moveRelative()} (WASD inputs are transformed to acceleration vectors, call {@code getInputVector()})
795
     *     <li>If not in liquid or gliding, limit motion when on climbable via {@code handleRelativeFrictionAndCalculateMovement()}
796
     *     <li>Invoke {@code [Entity].move()}
797
     *       <ul>
798
     *         <li>Apply stuck speed multiplier
799
     *         <li>Invoke {@code EntityHuman.maybeBackOffFromEdge()}
800
     *         <li>Handle wall collisions via {@code Entity.collide()} (speed is cut-off and the collision flag is set) <br>
801
     * <em><strong>After {@code [Entity].collide()} is called, the next movement is prepared. Every subsequent operation
802
     *           applies to the next move for the client.</strong></em>
803
     *         <li>Set the supporting block data; call {@code setGroundWithMovement()}</li>
804
     *         <li>Handle horizontal collisions (speed is now reset to 0 on the colliding axis); <em><strong>NCP STARTS ESTIMATING FROM HERE ON (!)</strong></em>
805
     *         <li>Invoke {@code checkFallDamage()} (apply fluid pushing if not previously in water)
806
     *         <li>Invoke {@code [Block].updateEntityAfterFallOn()} (for slime bouncing)
807
     *         <li>Invoke {@code [Block].stepOn()} (for slime blocks only, currently)
808
     *         <li>Invoke {@code tryCheckInsideBlocks()} (for honey blocks slide-down and bubble columns)
809
     *         <li>Invoke {@code [Entity].getBlockSpeedFactor()} (soul sand, honey blocks)
810
     *       </ul>
811
     *   </ul>
812
     * <li>Complete executing {@code EntityLiving.travel()}
813
     *   <ul>
814
     *     <li>{@code handleRelativeFrictionAndCalculateMovement()} (for snow climbing speed)
815
     *     <li>Apply gravity.
816
     *     <li>Apply friction/inertia.
817
     *     <li>Handle fluid falling function if in liquid (vertical axis only)
818
     *     <li>Handle jumping out of liquids (vertical axis only)
819
     *     <li>Handle entity pushing
820
     *   </ul>
821
     * <li>Complete {@code EntityLiving.aiStep()}
822
     * <li>Complete {@code EntityLiving.tick()}
823
     * <li> Finally, send movement to the server.
824
     * </ul>
825
     * <hr>
826
     * The logic is split into different sections:
827
     * <li>Firstly, we perform some preliminary checks to quickly catch specific ways of cheating.</li>
828
     * <li>If no blatant cheating is detected, the movement speed estimate is calculated starting from the horizontal collision reset, calculating the client’s actions on the next move and then processing the actions performed prior.</li>
829
     * <li>If needed, the player's impulse (acceleration) is brute-forced (see {@link BridgeMisc#isWASDImpulseKnown(Player)}</li>
830
     * @return {@code true}, if the move has been deemed to be predictable. {@code false} otherwise.
831
     */
832

833

834

864

865

            && (data.input.getForwardDir() != ForwardDirection.FORWARD && data.input.getStrafeDir() != StrafeDirection.NONE && data.input.getForwardDir() != ForwardDirection.NONE
887

888

918

921

928

931

932

933

934

935

936
                    // Multiply all combinations
937

938

939

941

956

957

958
        }
959

960

961

968

970

971

973

978

979

982

983

988

993

994

995

997

998

999

1000

1001

1002

1003

1004

1006

1007

1008

1009

1010

1012

1013

1014

1015

1016

1017

1018

1019

1020

1021

1022
            else {
1023

1024

1025

1026

1027

1030

1033

1035

1036

1041

1044

1059

1062

1064

1065

1067

1077

1118

1119

1120

1121

1122

1124

1126

1128

1129

1130

1132

1141

1142

            final double[] xMotionBeforeEdge, final double[] zMotionBeforeEdge, final PlayerKeyboardInput[] theorInputs, final float sinYaw,

1663

1664

1665

1666

1667

1668

1669
                seedX, seedZ, data, pData, from, pData.isInCrouchingPose(),

1671

1675

1676

1689

How it counteracts this module

SurvivalFly rebuilds the movement envelope from the server-side tracked location instead of trusting the packets. The first move of a flush has a delta equal to the whole distance walked during the silent gap, because the tracked position is where the server last saw the player and the first buffered C03 is where the blink started walking; the horizontal and vertical allowances from prepareSpeedEstimation and vDistRel are per-move physics bounds, so a gap of a few seconds produces a first move far over the allowance, a violation, and a set-back to the stored location. With pulse mode the gap is about a second and the first move stays small, so the pulse configuration trades the replay flag for the burst flag.

    /** On leaving a bed, check if the player had been in it. Prevents flying by faking bed-leave packets */
238
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
239
    public void onPlayerWake(final PlayerBedLeaveEvent event) {
240
        final Player player = event.getPlayer();
241
        final IPlayerData pData = DataManager.getPlayerData(player);
242
        final MovingData data = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingData.class);
243
        final MovingConfig cc = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingConfig.class);
244
245
        if (pData.isCheckActive(CheckType.MOVING_SURVIVALFLY, player) && survivalFly.checkBed(player, cc, data)) {
246
            // Check if the player has to be reset.
247
            // To "cancel" the event, we teleport the player.
248
            Location newTo = null;
249
            final Location loc = player.getLocation(useBedLeaveLoc);
250
            final PlayerMoveInfo moveInfo = aux.usePlayerMoveInfo();
251
            moveInfo.set(player, loc, null, cc.yOnGround);
252
            final boolean sfCheck = MovingUtil.shouldCheckSurvivalFly(player, moveInfo.from, moveInfo.to, data, cc, pData);
253
            aux.returnPlayerMoveInfo(moveInfo);
254
            if (sfCheck) {
255
                newTo = MovingUtil.getApplicableSetBackLocation(player, loc.getYaw(), loc.getPitch(), moveInfo.from, data, cc);
256
            }
257
            if (newTo == null) {
258
                newTo = LocUtil.clone(loc);
259
            }
260
            if (sfCheck && cc.sfSetBackPolicyFallDamage && noFall.isEnabled(player, pData)) {
261
                // Check if to deal damage.
262
                double y = loc.getY();
263
                if (data.hasSetBack()) y = Math.min(y, data.getSetBackY());
264
                noFall.checkDamage(player, y, data, pData);
265
            }
266
            // Cleanup
267
            useBedLeaveLoc.setWorld(null);
268
            // Teleport.
269
            data.prepareSetBack(newTo);
270
            SchedulerHelper.teleportEntity(player, newTo, BridgeMisc.TELEPORT_CAUSE_CORRECTION_OF_POSITION);
271
        }
272
        // Player was sleeping and is now out of the bed, reset.
273
        else data.wasInBed = false;
274
    }

    /** Temporary fix "stuck" on boat for 1.14-1.19 */
278
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST)
279
    public void onUnknowBoatTeleport(final PlayerTeleportEvent event) {
280
        if (!Bridge1_13.hasIsSwimming() || ServerIsAtLeast1_19_4) return;
281
        if (event.getCause() == TeleportCause.UNKNOWN) {
282
            final Player player = event.getPlayer();
283
            final IPlayerData pData = DataManager.getPlayerData(player);
284
            final MovingData data = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingData.class);
285
            if (data.lastVehicleType != null && standsOnEntity(player, player.getLocation().getY())) {
286
                event.setCancelled(true);
287
                player.setSwimming(false);
288
            }
289
        }
290
    }

293
    private boolean standsOnEntity(final Entity entity, final double minY) {
294
            // TODO: Probably check other ids too before doing this ?
295
            for (final Entity other : entity.getNearbyEntities(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)) {
296
                final EntityType type = other.getType();
297
                if (!MaterialUtil.isBoat(type)) {
298
                    continue;
299
                }
300
                final Material m = other.getLocation().getBlock().getType();
301
                final double locY = other.getLocation().getY();
302
                return Math.abs(locY - minY) < 0.7 && BlockProperties.isLiquid(m);
303
            }
304
        return false;
305
    }

    public void onPlayerChangedWorld(final PlayerChangedWorldEvent event) {

        data.clearMostMovingCheckData();

        final Location loc = player.getLocation(useChangeWorldLoc);

        data.setSetBack(loc);
318
        if (cc.loadChunksOnWorldChange) {
319
            MovingUtil.ensureChunksLoaded(player, loc, "world change", data, cc, pData);
320
        }
321
        aux.resetPositionsAndMediumProperties(player, loc, data, cc);
322
        data.resetTrace(player, loc, TickTask.getTick(), mcAccess.getHandle(), cc);
323
        // Just in case.
324
        if (cc.enforceLocation) {
325
            playersEnforce.add(player.getName());
326
        }
327
        useChangeWorldLoc.setWorld(null);

    }

351

353

355
            return;
356

        final MovingData data = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingData.class);

        final MovingConfig cc = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingConfig.class);

        final PlayerMoveInfo moveInfo = aux.usePlayerMoveInfo();

        final Location loc = player.getLocation(useToggleFlightLoc);

        moveInfo.set(player, loc, null, cc.yOnGround);

        aux.returnPlayerMoveInfo(moveInfo);

        useToggleFlightLoc.setWorld(null);

        data.addVelocity(player, cc, 0.0, 0.3, 0.0, VelocityFlags.FAKED);

    /** LOWEST checks, indicate cancel processing player move. */
428
    @EventHandler(ignoreCancelled = true, priority = EventPriority.LOWEST)
429
    public void onPlayerTeleportLowest(final PlayerTeleportEvent event) {
430
        final Player player = event.getPlayer();
431
        // Prevent further moving processing for nested events.
432
        processingEvents.remove(player.getName());
433
        // Various early return conditions.
434
        final TeleportCause cause = event.getCause();
435
        // We care only about these causes.
436
        switch (cause) {
437
            case COMMAND:
438
            case ENDER_PEARL:
439
                break;
440
            default:
441
                return;
442
        }
443
        final IPlayerData pData = DataManager.getPlayerData(player);
444
        final boolean debug = pData.isDebugActive(checkType);
445
        final MovingData data = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingData.class);
446
        final Location to = event.getTo();
447
        if (to == null) {
448
            // Better cancel this one.
449
            if (!event.isCancelled()) {
450
                if (debug) {
451
                    debugTeleportMessage(player, event, "Cancel event, that has no target location (to) set.");
452
                }
453
                event.setCancelled(true);
454
            }
455
            return;
456
        }
457
        if (data.hasTeleported()) {
458
            // More lenient: accept the position.
459
            if (data.isTeleportedPosition(to)) {
460
                return;
461
            }
462
            else {
463
                if (debug) {
464
                    debugTeleportMessage(player, event, "Prevent teleport, due to a scheduled set back: ", to);
465
                }
466
                event.setCancelled(true);
467
                return;
468
            }
469
        }
470
471
        // Run checks.
472
        final MovingConfig cc = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingConfig.class);
473
        boolean cancel = false;
474
        // Ender pearl into blocks.
475
        if (cause == TeleportCause.ENDER_PEARL) {
476
            if (pData.getGenericInstance(CombinedConfig.class).enderPearlCheck && !BlockProperties.isPassable(to)) { // || !BlockProperties.isOnGroundOrResetCond(player, to, 1.0)) {
477
                // Not check on-ground: Check the second throw.
478
                // TODO: Bounding box check or onGround as replacement?
479
                cancel = true;
480
            }
481
        }
482
        // Teleport to untracked locations.
483
        else {
484
            // Attempt to prevent teleporting to players inside of blocks at untracked coordinates.
485
            if (cc.passableUntrackedTeleportCheck) {
486
                if (cc.loadChunksOnTeleport) {
487
                    MovingUtil.ensureChunksLoaded(player, to, "teleport", data, cc, pData);
488
                }
489
                if (MovingUtil.shouldCheckUntrackedLocation(player, to, pData)) {
490
                    final Location newTo = MovingUtil.checkUntrackedLocation(to);
491
                    if (newTo != null) {
492
                        // Adjust the teleport to go to the last tracked to-location of the other player.
493
                        event.setTo(newTo);
494
                        NCPAPIProvider.getNoCheatPlusAPI().getLogManager().warning(Streams.TRACE_FILE, player.getName() + " correct untracked teleport destination (" + to + " corrected to " + newTo + ").");
495
                    }
496
                }
497
            }
498
        }
499
        // (Here event.setTo might've been called, unless cancel is set.)
500
501
        // Handle cancel.
502
        if (cancel) {
503
            // NCP actively prevents this teleport.
504
            event.setCancelled(true);
505
            if (debug) debug(player, "TP " + cause + " (cancel): " + to);
506
        }
507
    }

    @EventHandler(ignoreCancelled = false, priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)

    public void onPlayerTeleportHighest(final PlayerTeleportEvent event) {

514

522
        // TODO: What if not scheduled.
523
        if (data.hasTeleported()) {
524
            // Prevent cheaters getting rid of flying data (morepackets, other).

            if (!data.isTeleported(event.getTo())) {

530
                /*
531

            }

            if (pData.isDebugActive(checkType)) {
539
                NCPAPIProvider.getNoCheatPlusAPI().getLogManager().warning(Streams.TRACE_FILE, player.getName() + " TP " + event.getCause()+ " (revert cancel on set back): " + event.getTo());
540
            }
541
        }

    /** MONITOR: Adjust data to what happened.*/
546
    @EventHandler(ignoreCancelled = false, priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
547
    public void onPlayerTeleportMonitor(final PlayerTeleportEvent event) {
548
        // Evaluate result and adjust data.
549
        final Player player = event.getPlayer();
550
        final IPlayerData pData = DataManager.getPlayerData(player);
551
        final MovingData data = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingData.class);
552
        // Invalidate first-move thing.
553
        // TODO: Might conflict with 'moved wrongly' on join.
554
        data.joinOrRespawn = false;
555
        // Special cases.
556
        final Location to = event.getTo();
557
        if (event.isCancelled()) {
558
            onPlayerTeleportMonitorCancelled(player, event, to, data, pData);
559
            return;
560
        }
561
        else if (to == null) {
562
            // Weird event.
563
            onPlayerTeleportMonitorNullTarget(player, event, to, data, pData);
564
            return;
565
        }
566
        final MovingConfig cc = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingConfig.class);
567
        // Detect our own player set backs.
568
        if (data.hasTeleported() && onPlayerTeleportMonitorHasTeleported(player, event, to, data, cc, pData)) {
569
            data.clearWindChargeImpulse(); // Always clear this data.
570
            return;
571
        }
572
573
        boolean skipExtras = false; // Skip extra data adjustments during special teleport, e.g. vehicle set back.
574
        // Detect our own vehicle set backs (...).
575
        if (data.isVehicleSetBack) {
576
            // Uncertain if this is vehicle leave or vehicle enter.
577
            if (event.getCause() != BridgeMisc.TELEPORT_CAUSE_CORRECTION_OF_POSITION) {
578
                // TODO: Unexpected, what now?
579
                NCPAPIProvider.getNoCheatPlusAPI().getLogManager().warning(Streams.STATUS, CheckUtils.getLogMessagePrefix(player, CheckType.MOVING_VEHICLE) + "Unexpected teleport cause on vehicle set back: " + event.getCause());
580
            }
581
            // TODO: Consider to verify, if this is somewhere near the vehicle as expected (might need storing more data for a set back).
582
            skipExtras = true;
583
        }
584
585
        // Normal teleport
586
        final double fallDistance = data.noFallFallDistance;
587
        data.clearFlyData();
588
        data.clearPlayerMorePacketsData();
589
        data.setSetBack(to);
590
        // Important against concurrent modification exception.
591
        data.sfHoverTicks = -1;
592
        if (cc.loadChunksOnTeleport) MovingUtil.ensureChunksLoaded(player, to, "teleport", data, cc, pData);
593
        aux.resetPositionsAndMediumProperties(player, to, data, cc);
594
        // Reset stuff.
595
        Combined.resetYawRate(player, to.getYaw(), System.currentTimeMillis(), true, pData);
596
        data.resetTeleported();
597
598
        if (!skipExtras) {
599
            // Adjust fall distance, if set so.
600
            // TODO: How to account for plugins that reset the fall distance here?
601
            // TODO: Detect transition from valid flying that needs resetting the fall distance.
602
            if (event.getCause() == TeleportCause.UNKNOWN || event.getCause() == TeleportCause.COMMAND) {
603
                // Always keep fall damage.
604
                player.setFallDistance((float) fallDistance);
605
                data.noFallFallDistance = (float) fallDistance;
606
                // TEST: Detect jumping on a just placed fence.
607
                // 1. Detect the low correction teleport.
608
                // 2. Detect the fence.
609
                // 3. Verify the past move.
610
                // (4. Check for a block change entry or last placed block.)
611
                // TODO: REMOVE TEST
612
            }
613
            else if (fallDistance > 1.0 && fallDistance - player.getFallDistance() > 0.0) {
614
                // Reset fall distance if set so in the config.
615
                if (!cc.noFallTpReset) {
616
                    // (Set fall distance if set to not reset.)
617
                    player.setFallDistance((float) fallDistance);
618
                    data.noFallFallDistance = (float) fallDistance;
619
                }
620
                else if (fallDistance >= attributeAccess.getHandle().getSafeFallDistance(player)) {
621
                    data.noFallSkipAirCheck = true;
622
                }
623
            }
624
            if (event.getCause() == TeleportCause.ENDER_PEARL) {
625
                // Prevent NoFall violations for ender-pearls.
626
                data.noFallSkipAirCheck = true;
627
            }
628
        }
629
630
        // Cross world teleportation issues with the end.
631
        final Location from = event.getFrom();
632
        if (from != null && event.getCause() == TeleportCause.END_PORTAL // Currently only related to this.
633
            && !from.getWorld().getName().equals(to.getWorld().getName())) { // Less java, though.
634
            // Remember the position teleported from.
635
            data.crossWorldFrom = new SimplePositionWithLook(from.getX(), from.getY(), from.getZ(), from.getYaw(), from.getPitch());
636
            // Force close any inventory.
637
            Open.checkClose(player);
638
        }
639
        else {
640
            // Reset last cross world position.
641
            data.crossWorldFrom = null;
642
        }
643
644
        // Log.
645
        if (pData.isDebugActive(checkType)) {
646
            debugTeleportMessage(player, event, "(normal)", to);
647
        }
648
    }

    /** MONITOR level PlayerMoveEvent. Uses useLoc. */
698
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = false)
699
    public void onPlayerMoveMonitor(final PlayerMoveEvent event) {
700
        // TODO: Use stored move data to verify if from/to have changed (thus a teleport will result, possibly a minor issue due to the teleport).
701
        final long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
702
        final Player player = event.getPlayer();
703
        final IPlayerData pData = DataManager.getPlayerData(event.getPlayer());
704
        // This means moving data has been reset by a teleport.
705
        if (processingEvents.remove(player.getName()) == null) {
706
            return;
707
        }
708
        if (player.isDead() || player.isSleeping()) {
709
            return;
710
        }
711
        // Feed combined check.
712
        final CombinedData data = pData.getGenericInstance(CombinedData.class);
713
        final MovingData mData = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingData.class);
714
        data.lastMoveTime = now;
715
        mData.mcFallDistance = player.getFallDistance();
716
        final Location from = event.getFrom();
717
        // Feed yawrate and reset moving data positions if necessary.
718
        final int tick = TickTask.getTick();
719
        final MovingConfig mCc = pData.getGenericInstance(MovingConfig.class);
720
        if (!event.isCancelled()) {
721
            final Location pLoc = player.getLocation(useLoc);
722
            onMoveMonitorNotCancelled(player, TrigUtil.isSamePosAndLook(pLoc, from) ? from : pLoc, event.getTo(), now, tick, data, mData, mCc, pData);
723
            useLoc.setWorld(null);
724
        }
725
        else onCancelledMove(player, from, tick, now, mData, mCc, data, pData);
726
    }

     * (Which can be much more than 2)

    private void bukkitSplitMove(final Player player, final PlayerMoveInfo moveInfo, final Location from, final Location loc, final Location to,

                                 final boolean debug, final MovingData data, final MovingConfig cc, final IPlayerData pData, final PlayerMoveEvent event) {

1167

1168

1170
        }
1171

1172
            && processingEvents.containsKey(player.getName())) {
1173
            // Between -> set data accordingly (compare: onPlayerMoveMonitor).
1174
            onMoveMonitorNotCancelled(player, from, loc, System.currentTimeMillis(), TickTask.getTick(), pData.getGenericInstance(CombinedData.class), data, cc, pData);
1175
            data.joinOrRespawn = false;
1176
            // 2: Use player#getLocation() as the "from" location (loc -> to).
1177
            data.setPendingBukkitGround(player, data.playerMoves.getFirstPastMove());

            moveInfo.set(player, loc, to, cc.yOnGround);

            checkPlayerMove(player, loc, to, 2, moveInfo, debug, data, cc, pData, event, false);

1515
                    // Start counting ticks.
1516
                    hoverTicks.add(playerName);
1517
                    data.sfHoverTicks = 0;
1518
                }
1519
                else data.sfHoverTicks = -1;
1520
1521
                // Still check for NoFall.
1522
                if (checkNf) {
1523
                    noFall.check(player, pFrom, pTo, previousSetBackY, data, cc, pData);
1524
                }
1525
            }
1526
            else {
1527
                if (checkNf && cc.sfSetBackPolicyFallDamage) {
1528
                    if (!noFall.willDealFallDamage(player, from.getY(), previousSetBackY, data)) {
1529
                        mightSkipNoFall = true;
1530
                    }
1531
                    // Check if to really skip.
1532
                    else if (mightSkipNoFall) {
1533
                        if (!pFrom.isOnGround() && !pFrom.isResetCond()) {
1534
                            mightSkipNoFall = false;
1535
                        }
1536
                    }
1537
1538
                    // (Don't deal damage where no fall damage is possible.)
1539
                    if (!mightSkipNoFall && (!pTo.isResetCond() || !pFrom.isResetCond())) {
1540
                        noFall.checkDamage(player, Math.min(from.getY(), to.getY()), data, pData);
1541
                    }
1542
                }
1543
            }
1544
        }
1545
        // 2: Then creativefly
1546
        else if (checkCf) {
1547
            if (newTo == null) {
1548
                newTo = creativeFly.check(player, pFrom, pTo, data, cc, pData, time, tick, useBlockChangeTracker);
1549
                //if (checkNf) {
1550
                //    noFall.check(player, pFrom, pTo, previousSetBackY, data, cc, pData);
1551
                //}
1552
            }
1553
            data.sfHoverTicks = -1;
1554
        }
1555
        // No fly checking :(.
1556
        else data.clearFlyData();
1557
1558
        // 3: Morepackets.
1559
        if (pData.isCheckActive(CheckType.MOVING_MOREPACKETS, player) && (newTo == null || data.isMorePacketsSetBackOldest())) {
1560
            /* Always check morepackets, if there is a chance that setting/overriding newTo is appropriate, to avoid packet speeding using micro-violations. */
1561
            final Location mpNewTo = morePackets.check(player, pFrom, pTo, newTo == null, data, cc, pData);
1562
            if (mpNewTo != null) {
1563
                // Only override set back, if the morepackets set back location is older/-est.
1564
                if (newTo != null && debug) debug(player, "Override set back by the older morepackets set back.");
1565
                newTo = mpNewTo;
1566
            }
1567
        }
1568
        // Otherwise we need to clear their data.
1569
        else data.clearPlayerMorePacketsData();
1570
1571
1572
        ////////////////////////////////////////////
1573
        // Reset jump amplifier if needed.        //
1574
        ////////////////////////////////////////////
1575
        if ((checkSf || checkCf) && jumpAmplifier != data.jumpAmplifier) {
1576
            // TODO: General cool-down for latency?
1577
            if (thisMove.touchedGround || !checkSf && (pFrom.isOnGround() || pTo.isOnGround())) {
1578
                // (No need to check from/to for onGround, if SurvivalFly is to be checked.)
1579
                data.jumpAmplifier = jumpAmplifier;
1580
            }
1581
        }
1582
1583
1584
        ////////////////////////////////////////
1585
        // Update BlockChangeTracker          //
1586
        ////////////////////////////////////////
1587
        if (useBlockChangeTracker && data.blockChangeRef.firstSpanEntry != null) {
1588
            if (debug) debug(player, "BlockChangeReference: " + data.blockChangeRef.firstSpanEntry.tick + " .. " + data.blockChangeRef.lastSpanEntry.tick + " / " + tick);
1589
            data.blockChangeRef.updateFinal(pTo);
1590
        }
1591
1592
1593
        //////////////////////////////////////////////
1594
        // Check if the move is to be allowed       //
1595
        //////////////////////////////////////////////
1596
        // No check has requested a new to-Location (or actions are set not to cancel)
1597
        if (newTo == null) {
1598
1599
            // 1: An external hook has request a setback but actions are set to not cancel (or no check has requested a to loc)
1600
            if (data.hasTeleported()) {
1601
                data.resetTeleported();
1602
                if (debug) debug(player, "Ignore hook-induced set-back: actions not set to cancel.");
1603
            }
1604
1605
            // 2: Process the bounce effect if the move is allowed.
1606
            if (verticalBounce != BounceType.NO_BOUNCE) {
1607
                BounceHandler.processBounce(player, pFrom.getY(), pTo.getY(), verticalBounce, tick, this, data, cc, pData);
1608
            }
1609
1610
            // 3: Finish processing the current move, move it to past ones
1611
            // TODO: More simple: UUID keys or a data flag instead?
1612
            if (processingEvents.containsKey(playerName)) {
1613
                data.playerMoves.finishCurrentMove();
1614
            }
1615
            // Teleport during violation processing, just invalidate thisMove.
1616
            else thisMove.invalidate();
1617
            // Increase time since set back.
1618
            data.timeSinceSetBack ++;
1619
            return false;
1620
        }
1621
        // A check has requested a new to-location.
1622
        else {
1623
1624
            // 1: Setback override, adjust newTo.
1625
            if (data.hasTeleported()) {
1626
                if (debug) {
1627
                    debug(player, "The set back has been overridden from (" + newTo + ") to: " + data.getTeleported());
1628
                }
1629
                newTo = data.getTeleported();
1630
            }
1631
            if (debug) { // TODO: Remove, if not relevant (doesn't look like it was :p).
1632
                if (verticalBounce != BounceType.NO_BOUNCE) {
1633
                    debug(player, "Bounce effect not processed: " + verticalBounce);
1634
                }
1635
                if (data.verticalBounce != null) {
1636
                    debug(player, "Bounce effect not used: " + data.verticalBounce);
1637
                }
1638
            }
1639
1640
            // 2: Set back handling.
1641
            prepareSetBack(player, event, newTo, data, cc, pData);
1642
            return true;
1643
        }
1644
    }

    private boolean checkPastStateVerticalPush(final Player player, final PlayerLocation from, final PlayerLocation to,
1661
                                               final PlayerMoveData thisMove, final PlayerMoveData lastMove, final int tick,
1662
                                               final boolean debug, final MovingData data, final MovingConfig cc) {
1663
        final UUID worldId = from.getWorld().getUID();
1664
        double amount = -1.0;
1665
        boolean addvel = false;
1666
        final BlockChangeEntry entryBelowY_POS = BlockChangeSearch(from, tick, Direction.Y_POS, debug, data, cc, worldId, true);
1667
1668
        if (
1669
                // Center push..
1670
                entryBelowY_POS != null
1671
                // Off center push.
1672
                //|| thisMove.yDistance < 0.6 && from.matchBlockChange(blockChangeTracker, data.blockChangeRef, Direction.Y_POS, Math.min(.415, thisMove.yDistance))
1673
                ) {
1674
1675
            if (debug) {
1676
                final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(150);
1677
                builder.append("Direct block push at (");
1678
                builder.append("x:" + entryBelowY_POS.x);
1679
                builder.append(" y:" + entryBelowY_POS.y);
1680
                builder.append(" z:" + entryBelowY_POS.z);
1681
                builder.append(" direction:" + entryBelowY_POS.direction.name());
1682
                builder.append(")");
1683
                debug(player, builder.toString());
1684
            }
1685
            /*
1686
             * TODO: One case left still not covered, double ascend motions (0.25, 0.649)
1687
             * Mostly happen while jumping into block and piston push!
1688
             */
1689
            if (lastMove.valid && thisMove.yDistance >= 0.0) {
1690
                if ((from.isOnGroundOrResetCond() || thisMove.touchedGroundWorkaround) && from.isOnGround(1.0)) {
1691
                    amount = Math.min(thisMove.yDistance, 0.5625);
1692
                }
1693
                else if (lastMove.yDistance < -Magic.GRAVITY_MAX) {
1694
                    amount = Math.min(thisMove.yDistance, 0.34);
1695
                }
1696
                if (thisMove.yDistance == 0.0) {
1697
                    amount = 0.0;
1698
                }
1699
            }
1700
            if (lastMove.toIsValid && amount < 0.0 && thisMove.yDistance < 0.0
1701
                && thisMove.yDistance > -1.515 && lastMove.yDistance >= 0.0) {
1702
                amount = thisMove.yDistance;
1703
                addvel = true;
1704
            }
1705
            if (entryBelowY_POS != null) {
1706
                data.blockChangeRef.updateSpan(entryBelowY_POS);
1707
            }
1708
        }
1709
        // Finally add velocity if set.
1710
        if (amount >= 0.0 || addvel) {
1711
            data.removeLeadingQueuedVerticalVelocityByFlag(VelocityFlags.ORIGIN_BLOCK_MOVE);
1712
            /*
1713
             * TODO: Concepts for limiting... max amount based on side
1714
             * conditions such as block height+1.5, max coordinate, max
1715
             * amount per use, ALLOW_ZERO flag/boolean and set in
1716
             * constructor, demand max. 1 zero dist during validity. Bind
1717
             * use to initial xz coordinates... Too precise = better with
1718
             * past move tracking, or a sub-class of SimpleEntry with better
1719
             * access signatures including thisMove.
1720
             */
1721
            final SimpleEntry vel = new SimpleEntry(tick, amount, VelocityFlags.ORIGIN_BLOCK_MOVE, 1);
1722
            data.verticalBounce = vel;
1723
            data.useVerticalBounce(player);
1724
            data.useVerticalVelocity(thisMove.yDistance);
1725
            if (debug) {
1726
                debug(player, "checkPastStateVerticalPush: set velocity: " + vel);

            }

            return true;
1729
        }

        return false;

1735

1736

1737
    private BlockChangeEntry BlockChangeSearch(final PlayerLocation from, final int tick, Direction direction,
1738
                                               final boolean debug, final MovingData data, final MovingConfig cc,
1739
                                               final UUID worldId, final boolean searchBelow) {
1740
        final int iMinX = Location.locToBlock(from.getMinX());
1741
        final int iMaxX = Location.locToBlock(from.getMaxX());
1742
        final int iMinZ = Location.locToBlock(from.getMinZ());
1743
        final int iMaxZ = Location.locToBlock(from.getMaxZ());
1744
        final int belowY = from.getBlockY() - (searchBelow ? 1 : 0);
1745
        for (int x = iMinX; x <= iMaxX; x++) {
1746
            for (int z = iMinZ; z <= iMaxZ; z++) {
1747
                for (int y = belowY; y <= belowY + 1; y++) {
1748
                    BlockChangeEntry entryBelowY_POS = blockChangeTracker.getBlockChangeEntry(
1749
                    data.blockChangeRef, tick, worldId, x, y, z,
1750
                    direction);
1751
                    if (entryBelowY_POS != null) return entryBelowY_POS;
1752
                }
1753
            }
1754
        }
1755
        return null;
1756
    }

    /**
1802
     * Check for extremely large moves. Initial intention is to prevent cheaters
1803
     * from creating extreme load. SurvivalFly or CreativeFly is needed.
1804
     * On violations, also request an Improbable checking.
1805
     */
1806
    private Location checkExtremeMove(final Player player, final PlayerLocation from, final PlayerLocation to,
1807
                                      final MovingData data, final MovingConfig cc) {
1808
        // TODO: Recent Minecraft versions allow a lot of unhealthy moves. Observed so far:
1809
        // - Riptide + gliding (+ firework !?)
1810
        // - Really high levitation levels
1811
        // - Bouncing while riptiding
1812
        // (- High jump amplifiers might be a problem as well)
1813
        // One could also let Extreme_move block this stuff anyway, reason being:
1814
        // 1) we cannot support vanilla Minecraft features to arbitrary depths.
1815
        // 2) Why would one let players perform such moves anyway (which is usually bad news for server-sided chunk loading)?
1816
        // [In fact, even Mojang attempted to mitigate this: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/new-world-generation-java-available-testing]
1817
        // Thinkble: configurable option to block such moves (cc.blockUnealthyMove / cc.blockLegitExtremeMoves)
1818
1819
        final PlayerMoveData thisMove = data.playerMoves.getCurrentMove();
1820
        final PlayerMoveData lastMove = data.playerMoves.getFirstPastMove();
1821
        // TODO: Latency effects.
1822
        double violation = 0.0;
1823
        // Vertical move.
1824
        final boolean allowVerticalVelocity = false; // TODO: Configurable
1825
        if (Math.abs(thisMove.yDistance) > Magic.EXTREME_MOVE_DIST_VERTICAL) {
1826
            // Exclude valid moves first.
1827
            // About 3.9 seems to be the positive maximum for velocity use in survival mode, regardless jump effect.
1828
            // About -1.85 seems to be the negative maximum for velocity use in survival mode. Falling can result in slightly less than -3.
1829
            if (lastMove.toIsValid && Math.abs(thisMove.yDistance) < Math.abs(lastMove.yDistance)
1830
                && (thisMove.yDistance > 0.0 && lastMove.yDistance > 0.0 || thisMove.yDistance < 0.0 && lastMove.yDistance < 0.0)
1831
                || allowVerticalVelocity && !data.getOrUseVerticalVelocity(thisMove.yDistance).isEmpty()) {
1832
                // Speed decreased or velocity is present.
1833
            }
1834
            else violation += thisMove.yDistance; // Could subtract lastMove.yDistance.
1835
        }
1836
1837
        // Horizontal move.
1838
        if (thisMove.hDistance > Magic.EXTREME_MOVE_DIST_HORIZONTAL) {
1839
            // Exclude valid moves first.
1840
            // TODO: Attributes might allow unhealthy moves as well.
1841
            // Observed maximum use so far: 5.515
1842
            // TODO: Velocity
1843
            //final double amount = thisMove.hDistance - data.getHorizontalFreedom(); // Will change with model change.
1844
            //if (amount < 0.0 || lastMove.toIsValid && thisMove.hDistance - lastMove.hDistance <= 0.0
1845
            //    || data.useHorizontalVelocity(amount) >= amount) {
1846
                // Speed decreased or velocity is present.
1847
            //}
1848
            //else
1849
                violation += thisMove.hDistance; // Could subtract lastMove.hDistance.
1850
        }
1851
1852
        if (violation > 0.0) {
1853
            Improbable.check(player, (float)violation, System.currentTimeMillis(), "extreme.move", DataManager.getPlayerData(player));
1854
            // Ensure a set back location is present.
1855
            if (!data.hasSetBack()) data.setSetBack(from);
1856
            // Process violation as sub check of the appropriate fly check.
1857
            violation *= 100.0;
1858
            final Check check;
1859
            final ActionList actions;
1860
            final double vL;
1861
1862
            if (thisMove.flyCheck == CheckType.MOVING_SURVIVALFLY) {
1863
                check = survivalFly;
1864
                actions = cc.survivalFlyActions;
1865
                data.survivalFlyVL += violation;
1866
                vL = data.survivalFlyVL;
1867
            }
1868
            else {
1869
                check = creativeFly;
1870
                actions = cc.creativeFlyActions;
1871
                data.creativeFlyVL += violation;
1872
                vL = data.creativeFlyVL;
1873
            }
1874
            final ViolationData vd = new ViolationData(check, player, vL, violation, actions);
1875
            // TODO: Reduce copy and paste (method to fill in locations, once using exact coords and latering default actions).
1876
            if (vd.needsParameters()) {
1877
                vd.setParameter(ParameterName.LOCATION_FROM, String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f, %.2f, %.2f", from.getX(), from.getY(), from.getZ()));
1878
                vd.setParameter(ParameterName.LOCATION_TO, String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f, %.2f, %.2f", to.getX(), to.getY(), to.getZ()));
1879
                vd.setParameter(ParameterName.DISTANCE, String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", TrigUtil.distance(from, to)));
1880
                vd.setParameter(ParameterName.TAGS, "EXTREME_MOVE");
1881
            }
1882
            // Some resetting is done in MovingListener.
1883
            if (check.executeActions(vd).willCancel()) {
1884
                // Set back + view direction of to (more smooth).
1885
                return MovingUtil.getApplicableSetBackLocation(player, to.getYaw(), to.getPitch(), from, data, cc);
1886
            }
1887
        }
1888
        // No cancel intended.
1889
        return null;
1890
    }

    /**
1894
     * Called during PlayerMoveEvent for adjusting to a to-be-done/scheduled set back. <br>
1895
     * NOTE: Meaning differs from data.onSetBack (to be cleaned up).
1896
     * @param newTo
1897
     *            Must be a cloned or new Location instance, free for whatever
1898
     *            other plugins do with it.
1899
     */
1900
    private void prepareSetBack(final Player player, final PlayerMoveEvent event, final Location newTo,
1901
                                final MovingData data, final MovingConfig cc, final IPlayerData pData) {
1902
        // Illegal Yaw/Pitch.
1903
        if (LocUtil.needsYawCorrection(newTo.getYaw())) {
1904

1905
        }
1906
        if (LocUtil.needsPitchCorrection(newTo.getPitch())) {
1907
            newTo.setPitch(LocUtil.correctPitch(newTo.getPitch()));
1908
        }
1909
        // Reset some data.
1910
        data.prepareSetBack(newTo);
1911
        aux.resetPositionsAndMediumProperties(player, newTo, data, cc); // TODO: Might move into prepareSetBack, experimental here.
1912
1913
        // Set new to-location, distinguish method by settings.
1914
        final PlayerSetBackMethod method = cc.playerSetBackMethod;
1915
        if (method.shouldSetTo()) {
1916
            event.setTo(newTo); // LEGACY: pre-2017-03-24
1917
            if (pData.isDebugActive(checkType)) {
1918
                debug(player, "Set back technique: SET_TO");
1919
            }
1920
        }
1921
        if (method.shouldCancel()) {
1922
            event.setCancelled(true);
1923
            if (pData.isDebugActive(checkType)) {
1924
                debug(player, "Set back technique: CANCEL (schedule:" + method.shouldSchedule() + " updateFrom:" + method.shouldUpdateFrom() + ")");
1925
            }
1926
        }
1927
        // NOTE: A teleport is scheduled on MONITOR priority, if set so.
1928
        // TODO: enforcelocation?
1929
        // Debug.
1930
        if (pData.isDebugActive(checkType)) {
1931
            debug(player, "Prepare set back to: " + newTo.getWorld().getName() + "/" + LocUtil.simpleFormatPosition(newTo) + " (" + method.getId() + ")");
1932
        }
1933
    }

    /**
1936
     * Adjust data for a cancelled move. No teleport event will fire, but an
1937
     * outgoing position is sent. Note that event.getFrom() may be overridden by
1938
     * a plugin, which the server will ignore, but can lead to confusion.
1939
     */
1940
    private void onCancelledMove(final Player player, final Location from, final int tick, final long now,
1941
                                 final MovingData mData, final MovingConfig mCc, final CombinedData data,
1942
                                 final IPlayerData pData) {
1943
        final boolean debug = pData.isDebugActive(checkType);
1944
        // Detect our own set back, choice of reference location.
1945
        if (mData.hasTeleported()) {
1946
            final Location ref = mData.getTeleported();
1947
            // Initiate further action depending on settings.
1948
            final PlayerSetBackMethod method = mCc.playerSetBackMethod;
1949
            if (method.shouldUpdateFrom()) {
1950
                // Attempt to do without a PlayerTeleportEvent as follow up.
1951
                // TODO: Doing this on MONITOR priority is problematic, despite optimal.
1952
                LocUtil.set(from, ref);
1953
            }
1954
            if (method.shouldSchedule()) {
1955
                // Schedule the teleport, because it might be faster than the next incoming packet.
1956
                final IPlayerData pd = DataManager.getPlayerData(player);
1957
                if (pd.isPlayerSetBackScheduled()) {
1958
                    debug(player, "Teleport (set back) already scheduled to: " + ref);
1959
                }
1960
                else {
1961
                    if (debug) {
1962
                        debug(player, "Schedule a new teleport (isPlayerSetBackScheduled returned false, with teleported being set - set back) to: " + ref);
1963
                    }
1964
                    pd.requestPlayerSetBack();
1965
                }
1966
            }
1967
            // (Position adaption will happen with the teleport on tick, or with the next move.)
1968
        }
1969
1970
        // Assume the implicit teleport to the from-location (no Bukkit event fires).
1971
        Combined.resetYawRate(player, from.getYaw(), now, false, pData); // Not reset frequency, but do set yaw.
1972
        aux.resetPositionsAndMediumProperties(player, from, mData, mCc);
1973
        // TODO: Should probably leave this to the teleport event!
1974
        mData.resetTrace(player, from, tick, mcAccess.getHandle(), mCc);
1975

How it counteracts this module

NoCheatPlus enforces violations by teleporting the player: prepareSetBack records the target location and SchedulerHelper.teleportEntity issues the S08 with the correction-of-position cause, and the teleport bookkeeping in onPlayerTeleportLowest accepts only moves that reach the recorded position. When a set-back lands while the client is mid-blink, the client keeps walking locally and the buffered path starts from the pre-correction location, so the first flushed move diverges from the corrected server position, the envelope re-flags it, and NoCheatPlus set-backs again. A long blink against a server that corrects aggressively oscillates against the set-back until violations accumulate to the action threshold.

anticheat PlayerEventListener (teleport ledger and resync)

How it counteracts this module

Hawk records every server teleport in a per-player pending list and, in MoveEvent construction, drops incoming moves while a pending teleport is unanswered; a move farther than 64 blocks squared from the last accepted position triggers resync instead of being processed. The blink flush's first replayed move after a meaningful gap exceeds that squared distance, so Hawk discards the replay and resyncs the player, and the same drop logic swallows every replayed move that does not start from Hawk's tracked position. The pending-teleport timeout path, which clears the list and re-teleports after ping plus 40 ticks, is what ends a blink that outlived a rubberband.
